item.title: Warren Wilson Berea Baptist Church Hike — Fri Oct 16, 9:00 AM
item.description:
Asheville Mountains-to-Sea Trail Hiking Club 2.0 We'll meet at 9:00 a.m. on Riceville Road, across from Berea Baptist church and plan to leave no later than 9:10 a.m.
We'll hike in the woods along the Bull Creek Trail and over to the Swannanoa River trail and back. This is a gently undulating hike through serene woods and along peaceful waterways. We hike at about 3.2 mph.
Then length of this trail is 5-6 miles, depending upon how far we hike along the river; and we will return to the cars by 11:00 to 11:15. Well behaved dogs on leashes are welcome.
Mountains-to-Sea-Trail hikes are designed for fitness and community among people who are already reasonably fit. It's not an endurance hike by any means, but it is designed so we can get our hearts beating a bit while still being able to have a conversation and meet new people. The typical pace for a hike of this sort is 3.0 to 3.2 mph.

item.title: Bluegrass and Ice Cream — Sun Oct 18, 6:30 PM
item.description:
Hendo Fun Friends Gathering on the third Sunday evening each month in the Hendersonville Presbyterian Church (HPC) community room, a crowd of up to 200 people enjoy a special blend of bluegrass and gospel music interspersed with humorous anecdotes and inspirational messages — and free ice cream and cookies to boot!
Usually fewer than 20 percent of those attending are members of HPC. The rest of the audience comes from various backgrounds, denominations and ages to hear the combination of original gospel music and old-time Southern gospel songs. A love offering for the band is taken, but giving is strictly voluntary. HPC is located at the corner of Seventh Avenue and Grove Street. Parking is in the rear of the church and accessible from Grove and King Streets and from Sixth Avenue. For more information about the church and the Bash, visit hendersonvillepc.org or call the church office, 828-692-3211.
Source: Hendo Fun Friends

item.title: Rocky Fork Double - Abt 7 Miles, 1300 Ft EG, Maybe More — Mon Oct 19, 8:30 AM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group Rocky Fork State Park in in TN and about 40 minutes from the carpool area up I26 from Asheville. We will start out with the White House Cliffs out-and-back hike at just 2 miles but 1000 ft of elevation gain on the up section but a spectacular view at the top. After a short break at the cars, we will head up Flint Creek and probably just do an out-and-back. The trail crosses the creek several times on foot bridges and the fall colors should be spectacular. For those of you that did this hike with me last spring, I don't plan to do the loop with the deep water crossing at the end. It might be a little chilly for that on Monday but I could be convinced otherwise.
Bring some snacks for after the hike before we head back to Asheville. I hear someone is turning 67.

item.title: Weekly Critique — Wed Nov 4, 6:00 PM
item.description:
AVL Writers This is the standing weekly critique. Bring anything new you're working on to share with the group. If you don't have a project to share, you are most welcome to attend, discuss, and get inspired.
For our group discussion, please bring at least 8-10 printed copies of your piece. That way, we can all read through each other's work and provide feedback.
Sharing our creative efforts is an important part of the writing process. I'm really looking forward to reading what you've been working on. Don't worry if it's still a rough draft.
If you're having trouble finding us, look for a placard on the table with the group's name.
If you would like to join our group email list for updates regarding contests, events, and more [you can sign up on our website](https://avlwriters.com/).
